requirements.details: Async CLI documentation/suite/corpus checks prove inspection uses caller bindings. Allocation observation distinguishes zero clones on rejected Get Variable from one clone at exact capacity. Existing Log output/failure and registry/snapshot boundaries remain enforced for nine fixed slots.

requirements.requirement: Reusable no-op and cooperative sleep helpers plus documentation/examples
requirements.details: Sleep advances exactly 25 ms on a controlled clock; stop/deadline observations prevent the tail. Ordinary sync programs remain usable, while actual Sleep calls reject before argument effects. Example 28 and matching documentation execute all nine signatures including recovered assertion and explicit failure.

validation_scope: Full GNU/musl debug/release suites: 1,541 tests each; strict Clippy for both targets, formatting, coverage/mutation helper checks. Eight focused mutations (seven new plus retained lexical-parent mutation) use library/CLI unit, builtins, and allocation tests in an isolated source snapshot. No new generated campaign score is claimed.
review_notes: Initial tests exposed synchronous mode rejection caused by the fixed async Sleep registration. Only that fixed registration is now exempt from blanket sync-entry rejection; actual sync invocation still rejects before arguments, and user-supplied operation registrations retain the existing blanket policy.

CLI tests exposed missing bindings on worker contexts. Pure built-ins now use the evaluator context; arbitrary callbacks and Log retain the blocking-worker boundary. Async scope checks cover the repaired behavior.
Fixed catalogue growth changed snapshot/registry/listing boundaries. Boundary tests and the Rust snapshot example now account for nine fixed slots; no production quotas were raised.

Existing error-provocation fixtures that declared Fail with one parameter were renamed to Boom, preserving source positions and original diagnostic assertions. New default root signature collisions are documented.

The final matrix captures the clarified catalogue/mode/compatibility documentation and the mutation allocation oracle. A later README checkbox update preserves every executable fence; its before/after hashes are retained.
limits: This is the documented nine-signature standard catalogue, not complete Robot Framework BuiltIn API compatibility.

Rich assertion differences, structured expected/actual report artifacts, expected-failure DSL declarations and rerun integration, complete report files, and eventual-condition polling retain separate TODOs.
Sleep is cooperative and requires asynchronous invocation; it is not a host shutdown or forced-termination guarantee.
Worker peers predating BW9001/BW9002 reject those categories as unknown. All existing codes and wire framing remain unchanged.

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import subprocess, json, hashlib, re, tempfile, os
root=Path.cwd()
out=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="builtins-",dir=root/"target"))
print(f"validation record: {out / 'summary.json'}",flush=True)
inputs=[p for d in ('src','tests','examples') for p in (root/d).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts]
inputs += sorted((root/'docs').rglob('*.md')) + [root/'README.md']
inputs += [root/p for p in ('Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','.cargo/mutants.toml','scripts/coverage.py')]
record={'complete':False,'started':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'input_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in inputs},'checks':[]}
focused=['--test','setup_failure','--test','suite_fixtures','--test','documentation','--test','examples','--test','conformance']
commands=[('gnu-debug-full',['cargo','test','--locked']),('gnu-release-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--release']),('musl-debug-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl']),('musl-release-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--release','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl']),('clippy-gnu',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('clippy-musl',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('format',['cargo','fmt','--all','--','--check']),('coverage-helper',['python3','tests/coverage_tools.py']),('mutation-helper',['python3','tests/mutation_tools.py'])]

try:
 for label,command in commands:
  print('running '+label,flush=True)
  log=out/(label+'.log')
  with log.open('w') as stream:
   result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=1200,env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2'))
  content=log.read_text()
  rows=re.findall(r'test result: (?:ok|FAILED)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;',content)
  check={'label':label,'command':command,'status':result.returncode,'log':str(log.relative_to(root)),'tests':dict(zip(('passed','failed','ignored'),[sum(int(row[i]) for row in rows) for i in range(3)]))}
  record['checks'].append(check)
  (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps(check),flush=True)
  if result.returncode:
   print(content[-12000:],flush=True)
   raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 record['complete']=True
finally:
 record['finished']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
